characters.name: Zei
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego thread; national Minpentai champion and gifted cryptographer, now supervising drone combat for the Kungaupei and Veridia. Quick, precise, fluent technical explainer; playful with friends; tense, despairing and then elated during the battles (ch26, ch29-30). Occasionally speaks Dzegoban.

characters.name: Deluin
characters.voice_notes: Zei's friend and Minpentai rival from Redshire who went undercover as an Arctic commander. Warm, playful banter with Zei, then thoughtful and earnest when describing the Arctic Empire; sad about losing Redshire.

characters.name: Bai
characters.voice_notes: Minpentai player, formerly Zei's rival, now his close and affectionate ally. Confident, socially astute, a persuasive negotiator (ch28); steady and supportive under pressure (ch29); teasing humour.

characters.name: Mu
characters.age: older adult (described earlier as an older woman)
characters.voice_notes: Kungaupei member and former Minpentai tournament organiser, a mentor figure to Zei and Bai. Calm, soft-spoken, quietly brilliant improviser who stays cool in a crisis; gentle, with wry humour.

characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia thread; a Keeper in the Order of Steering, husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Thoughtful, earnest, calm and curious; in these chapters more confident and argumentative (pitches the court case to the judges), tender with his family. Occasionally speaks slow, careful Dzegoban.

characters.name: Seila
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's wife, blogger on economics and culture, mother of Zven and Lily. Sharp, warm, direct; the strategist behind the Silverchat poll (ch27); loving and protective with her children; calls Gladias 'Glad'.

characters.name: Lily
characters.age: teen (school age, exact age not given)
characters.voice_notes: Gladias and Seila's daughter, just freed from an Arctic boarding school in Northglade; emotional and apologetic at the reunion, then cheerful.

characters.name: Hreda
characters.age: teen (school age, exact age not given)
characters.voice_notes: Daughter of co-family Vil and Daia; math prodigy, bright, upbeat and articulate after months in the Greater Plum Harbor.

characters.name: Febric
characters.voice_notes: Son of co-family Vil and Daia; computer-science kid, calm, matter-of-fact, curious about Arctic food.

notes: No exceptions. D is Deluin throughout (Den is dead; this is Deluin's first spoken appearance since the earlier Dzego chapters). L is Lily (not Lektor), F is Febric (not Fin), H is Hreda. 31:29 contains a line of Dzegoban poetry spoken by Deluin. 31:70 is an N-coded message header (from Jahn, images only). All attributions confident.
